notes.title: DLC Japanese Garden 💮 Launch! + Jellyfish Update
notes.notes:
Hello Dear Aquarists! 🐠🐡🐟

Summer is just around the corner... and with it, [b]new update![/b]💫 Below we have listed all today's news, so feel free to read... 

[h3]Aquarist Japanese Garden DLC Available Now: [/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802320/Aquarist__Japanese_Garden_DLC/

Get DLC cheaper in a bundle: https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/40610/Aquarist_in_Japan

[list]
[*][b]New DLC for Aquarist is available![/b]🏯💮 [i]Japanese Garden DLC[/i] is an expansion with lots of new decorations and fish in a [b]Japan theme[/b] (yes!, there are carps, different types of goldfish and many others). In addition, we have access to a [b]completely new, huge location[/b] filled with tasks, which we can freely decorate and stock with fish. 🤩
An [b]additional exhibition-level quest[/b] is also available with the DLC. Do you want to discover [i]the secret of the Buddha[/i] and restore the Japanese garden to its [b]former splendor[/b]✨ while attracting many visitors? 

[*][b]Steam cards[/b] have been added to the game; now you can collect them by playing to your [b]Inventory[/b] on Steam! [b]Badges, backgrounds and emoticons related to the game are also available along with the cards![/b]

[*][b]New update with giant jellyfish![/b] Help the researcher find rare specimens in the underwater world and bring them to him. In return, you will get access to new species of jellyfish, including some really gigantic ones! 

[previewyoutube=EYVs7cT2CUY;full][/previewyoutube]

[*][b]New achievement[/b] related to jellyfish[/list]

[u][b]Done:[/b][/u][list]
[*] We have improved [b]using decorations with light, stone decorations remember their base color correctly[/b] ✅
[*] Improved [b]optimization[/b] on some levels ✅
[*] Fixed [b]blur settings[/b] that were not working properly on some levels ✅
[*] SailDart and StarDarter fish ignored aquarium conditions and could not die or display a bad condition icon. [b]Everything works fine now[/b] ✅
[*] Minor UI, optimization and bug fixes ✅[/list]

As always, [b]thank you for your help, heart, comments and contribution to the game[/b] 💙
Let us know how you like the new update and if you've played the DLC yet!

Sea ya! 
[i]Team Aquarist[/i]

P.S. Yesterday we announced a big and important game "[b]Purrrifiers[/b]". If you want to support us (Freemind or dev of the game) or have a chance to get into the beta test please wishlist now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2117430/Purrrifiers/

notes.title: Underwater Museum Major Update of full game! 🐟
notes.notes:
Hello our remarkable Friends! 🐟

Today we have a [b]big update[/b] of Aquarist game for you! We hope you'll find it useful and interesting ːsteamhappyː
Here it goes!

[previewyoutube=NrB5zy6BoTs;full][/previewyoutube]

Link to the game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1430760/Aquarist/

[u][b]A list of changes:[/b][/u][list]
[*]Added[b] two brand new locations!!![/b] ːsteamhappyː [b]The museum is the fourth full-fledged location [/b]where you can expand your [b]aquarium empire[/b]. 🐟
There are many [b]huge aquariums [/b]to prepare and exhibits to [b]find and assemble.[/b] Of course, first you have to [b]restore [/b]the place to its [b]old splendor and beauty,[/b] and surely visitors will be happy to come to visit the new place. Ahhh and we would forget, in the museum we will also meet a [b]special "guest" who you haven't seen for a long time and you surely missed him a lot![/b][i] (picture below related ːsteamhappyː)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/d7a2ce002fdfd3706a0bdeef5334aee0da5cfbb0.png[/img]

[*]The second location is a [b]huge underwater [/b]world where [b]many interesting adventures await you. [/b][b]A sunken Egyptian city and its mystery[/b] is waiting for you to discover it! By the way, finding new [b]specimens of fish, corals and decorations to use in your aquariums. [/b]Here you will also find [b]bones of extinct species[/b] that will allow you to[b] expand your Museum even more.[/b]
[*]Everythin[b]g is bigger in the museum location! [/b]Have you dreamed of inserting a shipwreck as the main decoration that will occupy the entire aquarium? [b]Here it is possible. [/b]Huge plants, decorations, stones, fish, you will find [b]all that in the new location[/b] [/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/bf0a5cb16c6b04068e7d6e68c367c4b52a05fb4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38900499/035c4a0266381602bab912617b1dde96c3394db4.png[/img]

[u][b]Other fixes:[/b][/u][list]
[*][b]placing plants in the ground will make them immediately set[/b], now by setting the plants we can choose exactly where we want them to be. This makes it easier and better to arrange aquariums!
[*][b]when scrolling information during inspection, the camera no longer skips[/b]
[*][b]fixed automatic feeders[/b], now the food in them does not renew accidentally when loading a save, but you have to manually refill them when the food runs out
[*]fixed fish stats UI, markers no longer go beyond the stats panel
[*]it is no longer possible to remove the same garbage several times in the first underwater level
[*]improved[b] visibility of texts in Asian languages[/b] in some places in the game where there was a problem with them
[*]it is no longer possible to [b]sell dead plants for money[/b], they must be thrown in the trash
[*]improved[b] visibility of warning markers[/b] above fish with something ailments
[*]in the oceanarium iat the entrance, lamp lights [b]no longer shine through the walls and do not illuminate the corridors behind the aquariums[/b]
[*]from now on, to swim faster in underwater levels,[b] you only need to have fins in your inventory[/b], you don't have to keep them selected in your inventory all the time to move faster
[*]many minor bugs have been fixed [/list]

Just to let you know our friends from Mercat Games are releasing first ever pirate🏴‍☠️ real time tactics strategy game ➡️ Frigato: Shadows of the Caribbean!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1667750/Frigato_Shadows_of_the_Caribbean/

Sea you later, guys ːsteamhappyː
Let us know how you like the newest update!
[i]Aquarist Team[/i]

notes.title: Language Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Aquarists!

We are very proud and happy to announce that from now on [b]you can enjoy the Prologue of Aquarist in 27 languages added to the game![/b]

Sei Italiano? Nessun problema! Are you from Russia? ничего сложного! Since the newest update you can read descriptions and dialogues in your native language and not worry about any missunderstandings...

[b]We hope our brand new update will bring you a lot of comfort and joy! ːsteamhappyː
[/b]
Aquarist Team

PS. If you spot any mistake, feel free to let us know by sending an e-mail to the adress [b][u]info@freemind.games[/u][/b] with a title [i]"Aquarist translation mistake - [here put the name of the language]"[/i]. We will happily improve the translations and let them serve you better!
